verdict.rationale: Cactus ships its own CLI, installed via brew, with `cactus run`, `cactus benchmark`, and `cactus convert [HF-Name]`. The convert command can pull and convert any HuggingFace model, though it is marked experimental, and the platform tier also lists a CLI among its interfaces. There is no evidence of model search, explicit download commands, or listing and deleting local models. missing for 10: a documented model search command, explicit CLI download/pull of catalog models, local model management (list/remove/update), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI model workflows.
